# 1 General Information

## 1.1 Specifications

Engine oil capacity 3.5 L. Coolant capacity 4.0 L.

![engine bay](images/manual_small/p3-1.png)

## 1.2 Maintenance Schedule

Replace spark plugs every 100 000 km.

# 2 Fuel System

## 2.1 Fuel Pump Troubleshooting

Symptom: engine cranks but does not start. Check fuel pressure at the rail: 320 kPa.

## 2.2 DTC P0171 System Too Lean

Inspect the intake for vacuum leaks. Refer to section 2.1 for pump checks.

# 3 Electrical

## 3.1 Battery

Battery voltage at rest 12.6 V. Charging voltage 14.2 V.
